plainText:
Shane Seeker (Japanese: カラバリ Karabari) is a character of the day who appeared in the episode Raid Battle in The Ruins!. He is a of Shiny Pokémon.

==History==
After obtaining a Shiny as his first Pokémon, Shane Seeker decided to complete his Pokédex with nothing but Shiny Pokémon, no matter how long it would take. In the episode Raid Battle in The Ruins!, he was exploring the Colossus Ruins in the Desert Resort, where he and his Psyduck were saved by and after they attacked the two that had trapped them inside.

Shane Seeker explained his profession and later joined Ash, Goh, , and the excavation in their exploration of the ruins. He also reluctantly participated in a Raid Battle against a , which the group defeated and Goh caught.

He reappeared in a flashback in Battling in the Freezing Raid!.

==Trivia==
Shane Seeker is the first in the who is known to own more than one Shiny Pokémon.
Netflix closed captions incorrectly refer to Shane Seeker as Shame Seeker.
His name is a play on the fan term "Shiny seeker".
